args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in production after deploy (healthy=false, error rate 18%) in us-east, us-west and eu-west. Rolled back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging before the production deploy. Follow-up: confirm recovery and find the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Problem:** Production was running v2.3.1 in us-east, us-west and eu-west. It was failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release marked healthy in production. us-east, us-west and eu-west are all on it now. The error rate dropped to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure, the rollback and the follow-up work: confirming recovery and finding what broke in v2.3.1.

v2.3.1's release candidate was already unhealthy in staging before v2.3.1 went to production. I noted this in the incident, since it suggests the release process didn't catch a failed staging check.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
